quality_note: Not independent: same assistant that authored initial predictions read later auto-captions after Git freeze. Creator-narrated repair actions and functional claims are not independent laboratory ground truth; match specificity reviewed strictly (exact family vs broad domain).

case_results.creator_reported_result: Touch works after restoration of the damaged tiny flex/connector contact path.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption narrative around 18:20–30:45 (connector contact/trace continuity work and touchscreen restored)

faults.reported_fault: Damaged/open microscopic touchscreen connector or flex contact continuity
faults.judgement: The plan located a touch interconnect path but did not predict a broken conductor/eroded pin and specific bridge.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Creator reports prior water damage, defective screen, and separate intermittent kinked screen ribbon; tablet subsequently boots repeatedly.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption retrospective explanation at 57:31–62:15; tablet responds repeatedly after replacement display and ribbon cable

faults.reported_fault: Failed display/screen assembly causing apparent dead tablet
faults.judgement: Black screen despite electronics alive was first-ranked and distinguishable with host enumeration.

faults.reported_fault: Kinked intermittent display ribbon during reassembly
faults.judgement: Interconnect mechanism independently anticipated; precise kink location unknown before teardown.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Creator replaced a failed thermal cutout and leaking upper-piston seals/assembly; machine subsequently made coffee.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption sections at 10:51–15:15 (failed thermal cutout) and 26:17–33:42 (O-rings and renewed coffee output)

faults.reported_fault: Failed heating thermal cutout / one-shot thermal fuse
faults.judgement: No thermal fuse or heat cutout hypothesis in three initial proposals.

faults.reported_fault: Pressure-water leakage through worn O-rings/upper piston
faults.judgement: Failure of hydraulic sealing was anticipated, but specific seal location was not.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Presenter attributes intermittency to motor heavily packed with dust; cleaning restores sustained operation and braking.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption sections at 32:53–35:33: heavy dust contamination on brushed motor; runs after service

faults.reported_fault: Dust contamination of brushed motor/commutation contact
faults.judgement: Plan considered motor/drive but failed to target contamination/commutator fouling as an actionable cause.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Dryer had restricted exhaust airflow from a sharply kinked external vent; machine itself was reportedly functional.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption explanation at 30:19–33:58: low-heat switch theory rejected, vent-hose kink removed and drying restored

faults.reported_fault: Restricted exhaust airflow from kinked external dryer vent hose
faults.judgement: First-ranked airflow restriction mechanism, although the particular vent kink was not specified.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Camera partly revived, display ribbon was repaired after additional damage, but creator could not establish original no-power cause and shutter remained unreliable.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption admission at 52:24–53:45: partial function returned but original no-power cause not established; shutter errors and damage introduced during repair

case_results.creator_reported_result: Treadmill restored after a small failed diode was replaced; repair also included correction of workshop-introduced wiring issues.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption at 70:42–71:46 identifies small diode; normal speed/incline shown around 66:24–70:25

faults.reported_fault: Failed diode in treadmill power/control circuit
faults.judgement: Generic internal control-board category is not an actionable prediction of a particular diode; no exact credit.

case_results.creator_reported_result: Shorted power-stage MOSFET removed/replaced; PSU showed output; console powered and displayed. HDMI port separately straightened.
case_results.review_provenance: Auto-caption at 05:28–09:43: shorted board MOSFET isolated and replaced; 11:23–11:48 power/display returned

faults.judgement: Board short/regulator fault was explicitly second-ranked, but no individual MOSFET named before measurement.

case_results.review_provenance: No caption-based or independent post-repair adjudication performed for this already sealed title-only case.
